Type: acceptance gate
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: F04
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend/integration engineer with identity administrator
Pilot scope: required

Outcome: One institutional identity provider authenticates stable principals with a usable and revocable browser session.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Use verified provider subject bindings; cover approved external collaborators, account disablement/recovery, expiry and logout without email-only identity merging.
2. Define session storage/transport, origin and request protections, secret rotation and current authorization; retain explicit service credentials rather than conferring arbitrary caller identity.
3. Qualify provider errors, invalid/stale sessions and contract behavior in automated fixtures; retain a selected-provider staging rehearsal before beta qualification. Missing real provider access stays an explicit open gate.

Review all child evidence against these integration criteria. Children closing does not automatically close this gate. Required human/institutional evidence must be observed, never inferred from automated tests.

Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
